Scientific plane address
M07 local frame (mm): +X right, +Y ventral, +Z cranial; plane n·x = d. Direction names follow NAV terminology discussed by Ruberte et al. (2025). The origin and dimensions belong to this M07 mesh, not to Ruberte et al. or Xenium.
Alveoli / air-sac data
No individual alveolar geometry is loaded. m07 provides near-acini compartments, which are not alveolar sacs. Independent micron-scale alveolar datasets cannot be placed into m07 without registration.

Illustrative enlarged airspaces throughout the lobes. Not measured M07 alveoli; not an alveolus count or histological section. Lower Lobe opacity to see inside. The independent measured ROI remains available separately.

Sources · measured vs schematic

M07 reference: deposited lapdMouse gross lung and airway geometry. No measured alveolar atlas is present in this model. M07 source.

E02 measured-data ROI: independently reconstructed projection data, with exploratory thresholded tissue surfaces. Different specimen; not registered to M07. Source dataset. This is not ground-truth alveolar segmentation.

Schematic airspaces: generated enlarged polyhedra (0.40 mm diameter, 0.65 mm spacing), not acquired anatomy. Positions, dimensions and counts are illustrative. Their 2D contours are geometric cuts of these same artificial shapes. Method: alveolar notebook, versions 2.9 and 3.0. No paper is cited as evidence for these invented dimensions.

Model & sources

M07 is a reference lung, not a registration of either Xenium section. The whole-lung airspaces are schematic; the E02 alveolar ROI is a separate measured specimen.

Sources
  • Bauer et al. (2020) — M07 lung anatomy.
  • Beichel et al. — source geometry archive.
  • Bolaños et al. (2021) — illustrative whole-body CT context.
  • Ruberte et al. (2025) — quadruped orientation terms.
  • Lovric et al. (2017) — independent alveolar ROI.

3D lung and airway model: Abel Lopez. Implementation and documentation: Codex (GPT-6).

2D section · reference mesh

All lobes and airway mesh, regardless of 3D visibility. Colors identify lobes. This 2D view intersects the M07 lobe and airway surface meshes at the selected plane; it does not contain cellular detail. When enabled, schematic airspaces show exact intersections of the enlarged display polyhedra, not measured histology. Airway color denotes the supplied surface intersection, not a validated lumen.

The plane controls explore this unrelated m07 reference. Selecting a day does not place that section on the 3D model. Required evidence: oriented block face, serial sections, or a specimen-specific 3D registration.

Source & reconstruction limits

Reconstructed from Lovric et al. public projection data. Surface = exploratory thresholded tissue interface, not individually segmented alveoli. Propagation fringes, missed thin septa and crop edges remain. Slice positions use ROI acquisition coordinates; they have no anatomical registration to the whole-lung model. Paper.
